tools.name: get_boost_options
tools.description: Lists Boost, Foundplay's paid promotion: each plan's price, guaranteed plays, days and placements, how refunds work, and the free boost line. Given a game, also says whether it can be boosted and gives a checkout link for each plan. A person must open the link, sign in and pay on Stripe themselves.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "creators" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing_link · Public sink: get_listing_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing_link · Public sink: get_listing_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
